title: Cyclotomic Catalan triangle conjecture
statement:
For a positive integer $\mu$, let $\omega=e^{2i\pi/\mu}$ and define the cyclotomic analogue by

$$
C_{n,k}^{(\mu)}=C_{n,k}(\omega,\ldots,\omega).
$$

Assume that $\mu$ divides $n+1$.

**Cyclotomic Catalan conjecture.**

$$
C_{n,n}^{(\mu)}=\frac{1}{\mu}\binom{n+1}{(n+1)/\mu}.
$$

These specializations are presented as cyclotomic analogues related to the cyclic sieving phenomenon. The excerpt provides no proof or resolution status.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14682

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2026).
source_name: Youssouf Wirdane, “Combinatorial study of the q-Catalan triangle and its generalizations”, arXiv:2605.14682 (2026).
